  <div class="rp-project-card">
    <div class="rp-project-tag">Writing Sample · Hedonic Price Study</div>
    <h3 class="rp-project-title">
      Hazard or Amenity? Flood Risk, Waterway Proximity, and Neighborhood Inequality in Housing Prices
    </h3>
    <p class="rp-project-desc">
      A hedonic study of 47,763 single-family home sales in Pierce County, Washington, linking parcel-level transactions with FEMA flood-risk designations, waterway proximity, and neighborhood socioeconomic data. The study shows that estimates of flood-risk capitalization are substantially confounded by waterfront amenity values and neighborhood context, and that flood-risk discounts vary significantly across income and racial composition of neighborhoods — raising distributional questions about who bears the cost of climate risk in housing markets.
    </p>
